interactions.label: Partner center · morning in the day room
interactions.description: Twenty participants settle in with coffee and conversation at the tables of a Seen-designed day room; the partner’s activities lead and aide run the floor.

interactions.label: Partner center · morning tai chi
interactions.description: Eight participants follow the activities lead under the slatted patio awning: the same repertoire as the Seen day room.

interactions.label: Visiting Seen PT · strength & balance
interactions.description: A Seen physical therapist visits the partner center for strength and balance with two participants who are also enrolled with Seen.

interactions.label: Visiting Seen RN · medication review
interactions.description: The visiting Seen nurse reviews medicines with two participants at the nurse station, with the partner’s own nurse.

interactions.label: Partner center · tabletop games
interactions.description: Games at the day-room tables after tai chi.

interactions.label: Partner center · lunch
interactions.description: The aide sets up and serves lunch in the dining room, with two places left open for wheelchairs.

interactions.label: Partner center · music
interactions.description: Seated music and clapping, led from the front of the day room.

interactions.label: Partner center · afternoon
interactions.description: Conversation at the tables until pickup.
